title: Firefighting Simulator: The Squad
tagline: Four firefighters, one squad — grind missions, water, and kilometres until the whole list is done.
order_note: Sections follow the walkthrough's route: tutorials, then the mission grind (Burning News, Explosive Hot Dogs, Inflaming of a Dumpster, Red-Hot Party!), multiplayer and victims alongside, the five trucks and the ladder tools, then the two big grinds — water and driving — last. Co-op makes both grinds far faster: water is shared between human players (30 hours solo, 7.5 with a full squad of four), and passengers earn driving kilometres too.
scope_note: All 30 achievements / 1,000G — the full game, no DLC. Route notes are paraphrased from the TrueAchievements walkthrough (single-page version). About 50–60 hours.

achievements.name: First Steps
achievements.how: Follow the intro's prompts — carry the victim to the ambulance gurney, then put out the garage fire with the hose.

achievements.name: Good Preparation
achievements.how: Complete every tutorial at the training facility (the target icon left of the map, above the Industrial Port). Follow the prompts — skipping steps in a couple of tutorials can stop it unlocking.

achievements.name: Firefighter Rookie
achievements.how: Complete your first mission — Burning News in Downtown is the walkthrough's pick. Deploy on scene and put out the fire.

achievements.name: Firefighter
achievements.how: Complete 5 missions — repeat Explosive Hot Dogs, skipping the start and end scenes.

achievements.name: Lieutenant
achievements.how: Complete 10 missions in one career.

achievements.name: Captain Competent
achievements.how: Complete 50 missions in one career — repeat Inflaming of a Dumpster (around 34 reps from the Explosive Hot Dogs stage).

achievements.name: Work Horse
achievements.how: Complete 100 missions in one career. It comes naturally during the water and driving grinds.

achievements.name: Part of the Team
achievements.how: Complete a mission with at least one other human player — no cross-play, and AI teammates don't count.

achievements.name: Team Player
achievements.how: Complete 10 multiplayer missions.

achievements.name: Me and the Gang
achievements.how: Complete 30 multiplayer missions.

achievements.name: You Are Not Alone – Ever!
achievements.how: Complete 50 multiplayer missions — you need another player (or a boosting account) for at least these 50.

achievements.name: You Saved My Life
achievements.how: Save a victim — carry them to the ambulance gurney, or order an AI teammate to do it. Victims rescued by AI count.

achievements.name: Getting it Done – Semi-Pro Lifesaver
achievements.how: Save 10 victims across your career.

achievements.name: Cannot Be Stopped
achievements.how: Save 100 victims — around 44 reps of Inflaming of a Dumpster (2 victims each) from the Explosive Hot Dogs stage.

achievements.name: Guardian Angel
achievements.how: Save 200 victims — 11 completions of Red-Hot Party! (9 victims each) or another 50 of Inflaming of a Dumpster.

achievements.name: TP3 Driver
achievements.how: Drive the Rosenbauer TP3 to a mission — it's the default truck; Red-Hot Party! is the walkthrough's pick.

achievements.name: Viper Driver
achievements.how: Drive the Rosenbauer Viper to a mission — Burning News, driving to the scene.

achievements.name: T-Rex Driver
achievements.how: Drive the Rosenbauer T-Rex to a mission — Burning News, driving to the scene.

achievements.name: Walk-In Rescue Driver
achievements.how: Drive the Walk-In Rescue to a mission — the Container and Pallets driving grind only offers the Walk-In trucks.

achievements.name: Command Walk-In Rescue Driver
achievements.how: Drive the Command Walk-In Rescue to a mission — the other Walk-In truck on the same grind.

achievements.name: Tool Master
achievements.req: Use Every Tool in the Game Once
achievements.how: Use every tool once at Oh, What a Shed! (west side of Lakeview Park): axe, crowbar (pry tool), Halligan, circular saw, fire extinguisher — air swings count. If it won't pop, drive to the scene, don't skip the cutscenes, and use the tools near a fire.

achievements.name: Firefighting Hero
achievements.req: Quench Fire with the Viper Nozzle
achievements.how: In Burning News with the Viper, extend the outriggers, choose 'Control Ladder' (not 'Climb Ladder'), rotate toward the news stand, switch to the nozzle and put out the flames.

achievements.name: A Brave Man up in the Sky
achievements.req: Quench Fire with the T-Rex Basket
achievements.how: In Burning News with the T-Rex, extend the outriggers, get in the basket, switch to the nozzle and extinguish at least one fire marker.

achievements.name: Spectacular Rescue
achievements.req: Save 1 Victim with the T-Rex Basket
achievements.how: In Red-Hot Party! with the T-Rex, leave one prone victim until everything else is done, carry them outside, walk around the T-Rex, extend the outriggers and get in the basket — the victim registers as saved.

achievements.name: Hose Operator
achievements.how: Use 1,000 litres of water with hoses — extinguishers don't count, and water used by AI doesn't count.

achievements.name: Spray and Quench
achievements.how: Use 10,000 litres of water with hoses.

achievements.name: Let it Flow
achievements.how: Use 100,000 litres of water with hoses. Idle it on Burning News: set up your hoses, toggle the water on, and don't let the AI fight the fire. Finish the mission about every hour or you lose the progress — solo it's about 30 hours, a full squad of four shares the water and cuts it to 7.5.

achievements.name: On the Road Master
achievements.how: Drive 50 km in one career — passengers earn kilometres too.

achievements.name: Asphalt Cowboy
achievements.how: Drive 100 km in one career.

achievements.name: Firefighting Forever
achievements.how: Drive 1,000 km in one career. Repeat Container and Pallets in Downtown — over 30 km per completion, about 33 runs, a little over 10 hours. You have 20 minutes to reach the scene per run; a good run takes just over 18.
